title: RoutineFiringContinuedPayload

firingId.description: A history entry's id, a firing's or a skip's: a UUID the environment mints; a firing's is its session's command id, so a retry after a crash makes nothing twice.

runId.description: The run that continues the firing after an update cut its last.

description: routine.firing-continued: an update cut the firing's run and the environment continued it; the firing follows the new run.
